ALGER, 27/06/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Oored: ALGIERS, 06/27/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Ooredoo Algeria is launching an unprecedented promotional offer called 'GIGAS CUP' to celebrate the matches of the Algerian national team during the World Cup. Subscribers can activate the offer for free and win up to 10 gigabytes (GB) of mobile data per Algerian victory.
Lancement de l’offre GIGAS CUP pour acco: Launch of the GIGAS CUP offer to support the Atlas Lions
Ooredoo Algérie a annoncé hier le lancem: Ooredoo Algeria announced yesterday the launch of an exceptional promotional campaign, 'GIGAS CUP', dedicated to supporters of the Algerian national football team. This initiative, accessible via the 'My Ooredoo' mobile application, allows subscribers to benefit from 10 gigabytes (GB) of free mobile data after each Algerian victory in the World Cup. The offer is valid for all Ooredoo customers, whether prepaid or postpaid, and covers all national team matches.
Pour activer l’offre, les utilisateurs d: To activate the offer, users must download the 'My Ooredoo' application from the dedicated link (https://ore.do/sm-w) and follow the instructions to activate the 'GIGAS CUP' feature. Once the victory is confirmed, the data is automatically credited to the subscriber's account. This initiative is part of the operator's strategy to strengthen its commitment to supporters and celebrate the country's sporting achievements.
Cette campagne intervient à un moment ch: This campaign comes at a pivotal time for the telecommunications sector in Algeria, where the demand for mobile data is experiencing exponential growth. With a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% in 2025, operators are competing to capture consumer attention, particularly during major sporting events. The 'GIGAS CUP' offer allows Ooredoo to differentiate itself by capitalizing on the popular enthusiasm surrounding the World Cup, while boosting the use of its digital services.
Sur le plan économique, cette initiative: On the economic front, this initiative could generate an increase in data traffic, which will indirectly benefit the operator's revenues. Furthermore, it strengthens customer loyalty and attracts new subscribers, thereby contributing to the momentum of the telecom market in Algeria. For supporters, the offer represents a concrete opportunity to enjoy the matches without worrying about their data limits.
Contexte du secteur TIC algérien: Context of the Algerian ICT sector
Le secteur des télécommunications en Alg: The telecommunications sector in Algeria is undergoing a major transformation, driven by an ambitious digital policy. According to the latest data from ARPCE (Regulatory Authority for Post and Telecommunications), the mobile penetration rate reached 125% in 2025, with more than 60 million active lines for a population of 45 million. The number of internet subscribers has also exceeded 30 million, reflecting massive adoption of digital services.
Dans ce cadre, le plan numérique 2030 vi: In this context, the 2030 Digital Plan aims to accelerate the transition to a digital economy, with massive investments in infrastructure. Algérie Télécom, the historical operator, has committed more than 200 billion Algerian dinars (DA) to the deployment of 5G and the improvement of network coverage. The three mobile operators (Algérie Télécom Mobile, Mobilis, and Djezzy) are competing to offer innovative services, as evidenced by Ooredoo's 'GIGAS CUP' initiative.
Le lancement de l’offre 'GIGAS CUP' a ét: The launch of the 'GIGAS CUP' offer was praised by the executives of Ooredoo Algeria. The operator's General Manager, Mr. Amine Ferragui, stated: "This campaign reflects our commitment to supporting the national team and celebrating Algeria's sporting successes. We are proud to contribute to this momentum by offering tangible benefits to our customers."
Cette initiative a également suscité des: This initiative also sparked positive reactions on social media, where many supporters expressed their satisfaction with this proposal. Some users emphasized the importance of such offers in strengthening national cohesion around sporting events.
Ooredoo Algérie prévoit de maintenir cet: Ooredoo Algeria plans to maintain this campaign throughout the World Cup, with a possible extension if Algeria qualifies for the subsequent phases. The operator could also introduce other similar promotional offers during other major sporting or cultural events.
À plus long terme, cette initiative s’in: In the longer term, this initiative is part of a broader strategy aimed at positioning Ooredoo as a key digital player in Algeria. The operator continues to invest in innovation, notably through the development of digital services and the improvement of the customer experience. The next steps include the deployment of new features in the 'My Ooredoo' application and the introduction of personalized services to meet the evolving needs of consumers.
